mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (below 3.5%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals economic weakness that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) indicates a stagflationary environment that erodes corporate profit margins and increases uncertainty, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals reduced output capacity and higher input costs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO declines during a supply shock regime.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate above 1500 thousand units signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, boosting corporate revenues and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of employment (PAYEMS > 158000) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 158000 and UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 325), persistent price increases erode purchasing power and lead to aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 325.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO > 100) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and investor sentiment, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 100.
